description.description: what you send, to whom, and why they expect it

completed_at.description: when the batch reached its final status

cost_rial.description: charged amount, refunds for refused messages deducted

sender_ip.description: masked sender address: 85.133.133.x, or the first three IPv6 groups followed by :x

code.description: insufficient_balance (402), identity_needed (403), forbidden (403), account_suspended (403), validation_failed (422), not_found (404), rate_limited (429)

from.description: sender line number or id; the account's default line when absent

receptor.description: recipient mobile (required with an API token; from a panel session only your own mobile, the default)

template.description: an approved template's id or name

cost_rial.description: 0 for a message the provider refused

operator.description: recipient's operator by number prefix (best effort: ported numbers keep their original prefix)

error_code.description: raw submit error code when the provider refused the message

message_id.description: the provider's message id (operator tracking number)

queued_at.description: when the message was created and queued

status.description: queued: waiting to be sent; sent: accepted by the operator; delivered: reached the handset; failed: the provider refused it (not charged); undelivered: the operator accepted it but it did not reach the handset; rejected; expired

timeline.description: ordered by at ascending; synthesized from the message's timestamps for messages created before the event log existed

type.description: queued: created; sent_to_provider: accepted by the provider; provider_refused: refused at submit (refunded); status_checked: a delivery check returned a non-final code (0 = no status yet); delivered_to_operator: code 8, reached the telecom; delivered: code 1; not_delivered: code 2; not_sent_to_operator: code 16; expired: code -1 or the 24h window ended; rejected: blocked locally

billing_unit.description: What unit_rial is charged per: one message (default, SMS_BILLING_QUANTITY=messages) or one SMS part

client_reference.description: idempotency reference; the Idempotency-Key header is used when absent

template_id.description: an approved template's id or name; required (free text is not accepted)

tokens.description: a value for every {placeholder} of the template: one line, at most 40 characters, no link, domain or phone number

status.description: only an approved template can be sent; a changed body is reviewed again

body.description: service text with {placeholders} (lower-case letters, digits, _); advertising is rejected

events.description: Subscribed per-message events; empty until the customer chooses some (batch.completed is always sent)

secret_hint.description: masked tail of the signing secret; the full secret is only returned by POST /webhook/secret

WebhookBatchEvent.description: Sent once when a batch reaches a final status. data is the Batch object. For existing receivers the original flat fields are kept at the top level as well: batch_id, client_reference, status (stored value: sent, partially_sent or failed), total_recipients, delivered_count, failed_count, completed_at.

WebhookEventName.description: Subscribable webhook events. batch.completed is always sent and cannot be unsubscribed.

WebhookInboundEvent.description: An SMS received on one of the customer's dedicated lines; data is the Inbound object.

WebhookMessageEvent.description: Event message.delivered or message.failed (event is the one that happened). data is the Message as GET /messages/{message} returns it, in its final state (status delivered for message.delivered; failed, undelivered, rejected or expired for message.failed).

info.description:
Served as /v1/* by sms-service (api.ariaservice.net/sms/v1/*). Authenticate with the session from POST /auth/exchange (the gateway does this for API tokens). The same handlers serve the panel on /api/sms/*. Token scopes: sms:messages:read, sms:messages:write, sms:lines:read, sms:templates:read, sms:templates:write.

Webhooks: configure with PUT /webhook. Each delivery is a POST of {event, occurred_at, data} to your URL with header X-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed with your webhook secret; answer 2xx, other answers are retried 5 times with growing delays. Events: message.delivered and message.failed (per message, final delivery state) and inbound.received are sent only when listed in the webhook's events (none by default); batch.completed is always sent. See the WebhookMessageEvent, WebhookInboundEvent and WebhookBatchEvent schemas.
